**Real Madrid roll into Mestalla on a five-game tear, while Valencia are limping along with injuries piling up like autumn leaves.** This is classic David-and-Goliath — except Madrid's been playing god-mode football lately. ⚽

Valencia grabbed a win over Elche but sandwiched it with draws and losses; Real Madrid hasn't dropped a single point in their last five. - **Jude Bellingham's** midfield dominance against a mid-table side should set the tone early

przeciw: Vinícius Júnior jest zawieszony i nie może zagrać w tym meczu, co stanowi ogromne osłabienie siły ofensywnej Realu Madryt (źródło: teczka).
